test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6fedc6a77781f06059decc262d36301b85124dda6b939214a3d242f0f3be0be.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The arrow is rotated according to 135° anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/668e747a719a7b4048e3eb5492296342d99b678536d93c9fe2c788426bfa2c72.png] 

3) The square is rotated according to 90° anticlockwise ,then rotate diagonally, then 90° anticlockwise and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09698116a1fd0d497a8c7de529f979cdb637de3d7f1ef3b9faf51f66e6b058e4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**
